name: dispatch
description: Dispatch engineering work end-to-end: pull request lifecycle (drafting, review, CI triage, merge) and ticket-tracker project orchestration (triage, planning, status, cross-team sync) — Linear bundled, other trackers added by writing an adapter.

copilot_available.title: Copilot review available
copilot_available.description: Whether GitHub Copilot review is expected to work on this installation. Set to false on GitHub Enterprise installations without Copilot review — the `deliver` skill will skip the Copilot phase and go straight to human review.

worktree_base.title: Worktree base directory
worktree_base.description: Root directory under which the `deliver` skill creates per-PR worktrees. Layout: <base>/<owner>/<repo>/<branch>.

team_mode.title: Team mode
team_mode.description: When true, /deliver adds a private review stage in draft (operator only) before clearing draft for public review (team). When false (default), /deliver clears draft after Copilot and the operator is the public reviewer — no separate private stage.

operator_login.title: Operator GitHub login
operator_login.description: GitHub login of the operator directing this agent. Required — the deliver skill and pr-status script always assume it is set. Targets the operator with PR review requests (Mode A) and classifies <review> elements in pr-status XML; the agent never falls back to the ticket assigner. In Mode B (shared credentials) set this to the shared/authenticated account.

tracker.title: Work-item tracker
tracker.description: Default work-item tracker for `work-ticket`, named by the id of its adapter file (`linear` ships with the plugin). For ticket-backed work the tracker is resolved from the ticket's URL; this value is the fallback when the URL is ambiguous or the input is a bare id. (A bare PR has no ticket and is driven on the forge via the deliver skill regardless.) A tracker with no adapter errors rather than guessing.

tracker_adapters_dir.title: Tracker adapters directory
tracker_adapters_dir.description: Directory of your own tracker adapters — one `<tracker-id>.md` per tracker, binding the work-ticket role vocabulary and ticket operations to that platform. Searched after the repo's `.claude/dispatch/trackers/` and before the adapters bundled with the plugin, so a file here adds a tracker (Jira, GitLab, an internal tool) or replaces the bundled mapping for one, without editing the skill. Start from the TEMPLATE.md in the plugin's work-ticket trackers directory; see the plugin README.
